name: Kiriya Fujino
source:
[i]The Fourth daughter who died young[/i]

Deceased. She had a calm demeanor for her age, and was intelligent and possessed eyes that seemed to see through everything.

To her younger sisters Kurenai and Sumire, she was a kind older sister who taught them many things, but to Nadeshiko and Ai, she was a sister who was too intelligent and gave the impression of being somewhat fragile.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
